questions.prompt: Which of the following is a property of a normal distribution?
options: A. The mean, median, and mode are all equal
B. The distribution is skewed right
C. The total area under the curve is greater than 1
D. The curve touches the x-axis at three standard deviations from the mean
hints: The area under the curve must be exactly 1.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: In a normal distribution, the mean, median, and mode are equal, and the curve is symmetric.

questions.prompt: The total area under a normal curve is ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The total area under a normal curve is 1.

questions.prompt: If normal curve A is more spread out than normal curve B, which curve has the greater standard deviation?
options: C. Both have the same standard deviation
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Curve A has the greater standard deviation because it is more spread out.

questions.prompt: If $\mu = 50$, $\sigma = 5$, and $x = 60$, what is the z-score?
What is the mean of the standard normal distribution?
options: C. It depends on the data
hints: The standard normal distribution is centered at 0.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard normal distribution has a mean of 0.

hints: Check the absolute value of each.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A z-score of -2.3 has absolute value greater than 2, so it is unusual.

questions.prompt: The standard normal table gives the cumulative area to the ___ of a z-score.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard normal table gives area to the left of a z-score.

questions.prompt: If the area to the left of $z = 1.5$ is 0.9332, what is the area to the right of $z = 1.5$?
To find the area between $z = -1.5$ and $z = 1.25$, which calculation is correct?
hints: Area between = larger area - smaller area.
Find area left of each z-score and subtract.

questions.prompt: Where are the inflection points on a normal curve?
options: D. At the points where the curve crosses the x-axis
hints: Inflection points are one standard deviation from the mean.
They mark the change in curvature.

questions.prompt: A z-score of -2 means the value is 2 standard deviations ___ the mean.
hints: Negative z-score indicates a value less than the mean.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A negative z-score means the value is below the mean.

questions.prompt: Which of the following describes the standard normal distribution?
hints: The standard normal is centered at 0.
Its standard deviation is the unit of measurement on the z-scale.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard normal distribution has mean 0 and standard deviation 1.

questions.prompt: The standard deviation of the standard normal distribution is ___.
hints: It is the unit on the z-scale.
The mean is 0 and this value is 1.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard deviation of the standard normal distribution is 1.
